profile.headline: Engineering @ Planning Center
profile.summary: I am currently a Senior Fullstack Engineer at Calendly, and loving it!

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected and lead a team of 4 developers through a migration from AngularJS to Angular 8 to make page load times 2-3 times faster, modernize our technical stack, and allow developers to use more modern tools (Typescript, Angular CLI,
etc) to maintain the application
- Lead architecture and implementation of payment gateway (Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL) for processing credit card transactions from our edge devices to various payment partners, following PCI and EMV specifications
- Partnered with senior architect to lead a team of 2 developers to port a a 20+-year-old piece of software responsible for managing edge devices from C to Java so that we could improve maintainability and allow additional developers to contribute to the codebase as the majority of our engineers are proficient in Java
- Worked alongside testing architects to stand up an ELK stack for log aggregation and data analytics which is currently being utilized in our testing environment
- Authored many testing tools, mostly written in python. Examples include simulating vehicle behavior, simulating credit card transactions, etc
- Lead ad hoc department-wide trainings on ELK stack, Python, Angular, and other job-specific duties
- Lead ad hoc training sessions on internal tools to enable customer service department to better meet customer needs
- Designed an internal Angular library for abstracting advanced form creation out of HTML and into Typescript allowing our team to more quickly develop and create forms in a type-safe environment
- Mentored junior developers through code reviews and architecture reviews as a member of the architecture team

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Worked alongside business partners to facilitate loading and fetching of denormalized client data for analytics purposes
- Utilized Perl and Oracle SQL to consolidate client data in a quickly accessible form
- Utilized AngularJS and Perl to create analytics interface for presenting KPIs to clients in real time
-Tuned performance of Oracle SQL queries
- Created Angular JS frontend components and unit tests to improve modularity and code quality
- Developed internal tools to streamline Agile experience: spring planning documents, backlog management tools, Slack integrations, etc
- Lead Agile Meetings (sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and backlog grooming)
- Lead adhoc training sessions on Kibana, Oracle SQL performance best practices, and other job specific duties

positions.title: Tutor (Computer Science, Christianity, Study Skills)
positions.description: Tutor students in all Computer Science classes, lower-level Christianity classes, and general study skills.

positions.title: Coordinator of Personnel and Morale
positions.description: Helped with disciplinary actions towards student employees, helped raise morale and job satisfaction of student employees, lead tour groups, helped run seminars.

positions.title: Lab Assistant
positions.description: Aid students and peer tutors in daily activities, answer phones, file paperwork.

positions.title: Student Programer
positions.description:
Created an Eclipse IDE plugin named The Eclipse Array Explorer with the help of members of the Vienna Institute of Technology. This project was totally created in Java.

https://sites.google.com/site/eclipsearrayexplorer/home
